svg.text: Глава 8 · Технология первичных сетей OTN
Олифер, 7-е изд. · RAG p0242:c01–p0267:c01 · PDF 242–267 · printed 241–266
1 · Primary / transport network model
Static circuit-switched point-to-point channels
Overlay computer/telephone networks consume these channels
TM terminates · ADM add/drops · DXC cross-connects · regenerators restore signal
Tributary ports feed aggregate/line ports
Capacity/path must be planned before service; no packet-style dynamic routing in source model
2 · PDH → SDH → OTN evolution
PDH → bit stuffing; extraction requires hierarchical demultiplexing
SDH → pointers + virtual containers; easier add/drop/cross-connect
SDH problem set → small switching units, computer-traffic inefficiency, weak DWDM integration
OTN keeps hierarchy/TDM/equipment ideas but redesigns transport blocks
Source treats PDH/SDH largely as historical context for modern OTN
3 · OPU / ODU / OTU functional chain
OPU → map client payload + align client/OTN rate
ODU → end-to-end monitoring/management + multiplexing
OTU → adjacent-node transport + FEC + alignment/section overhead
Photonic layer → carry OTU through a DWDM spectral channel
OTN processing is O-E-O in source description
Do not collapse these three block types into one generic “OTN frame” concept
4 · Frame, FEC and client adaptation
Fixed OTN frame size · transmission time shrinks at higher hierarchy rate
OTU FEC → source specifies Reed–Solomon RS(255,239)
Synchronous clients → direct alignment procedures
Bursty/frame clients → GFP envelope; idle periods can be filled with empty GFP frames
GFP-F → frame mode · GFP-T → transparent mode
Exact FEC gains and rates are source claims/snapshots, not universal guarantees
5 · OTN multiplexing
Lower-order ODU blocks → higher-order OPU/ODU payload
Tributary Slots → byte-interleaved multiplexing resources
PSI → slot position ↔ ODU type ↔ tributary-port association
ODU0/ODU2e/ODU4/ODUCn → hierarchy extended for Ethernet generations
ODUFlex + GMP → arbitrary-rate client adaptation
6 · OTN/DWDM architecture evolution
Transponder → one client wrapped into one DWDM wavelength
Muxponder → aggregate several clients into a faster OTU wavelength
OTN cross-connect → transit switching between tributary/aggregate ports
ROADM DWDM provides spectral channels between OTN switching nodes
Architecture shifts from “digital wrapper” to a true transport switching fabric
Operational reading rule
Start with client/container mapping and provisioned circuit state; do not troubleshoot OTN as if it were IP routing.
Trace OPU/ODU/OTU → tributary slots/PSI → cross-connect → underlying DWDM section → end-to-end receive integrity.
No executable CLI is supplied by the chapter.
Chapter 9 starts at p0268:c01 · reading state unchanged · source findings recorded separately.
